description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering candidate search parameters in a recruitment plugin of an HR management system. It contains properties for various search filters, default sorting settings, and accessor methods.

classes.name: CandidateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating various search filter parameters used to query candidates in the recruitment system.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the candidate ID filter value.

methods.name: setCandidateId
methods.description: Sets the candidate ID filter value.

methods.name: getVacancyId
methods.description: Returns the vacancy ID filter value.

methods.name: setVacancyId
methods.description: Sets the vacancy ID filter value.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID filter value.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID filter value.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Returns the candidate-vacancy ID filter.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Sets the candidate-vacancy ID filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getHiringManagerId
methods.description: Returns the hiring manager ID filter.

methods.name: setHiringManagerId
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager ID filter.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the application's status filter.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the application's status filter.

methods.name: getMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the method of application filter.

methods.name: setMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Sets the method of application filter.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter for search.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter for search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter for search.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter for search.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Returns keywords filter.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets keywords filter.

methods.name: getCandidateName
methods.description: Returns the candidate name filter.

methods.name: setCandidateName
methods.description: Sets the candidate name filter.

methods.name: getCandidateIds
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate IDs.

methods.name: setCandidateIds
methods.description: Sets an array of candidate IDs.

methods.name: isConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Returns the consent to keep data flag.

methods.name: setConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Sets the consent to keep data flag.
